title: What Languages do People Speak in Nigeria?
text: Deaf people in Nigeria generally communicate with Nigerian Sign Language. It was developed primarily from American Sign Language and was introduced in 1960 – the year that Nigeria gained independence – by a missionary named Andrew Foster.
